Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …),

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

As part of our growth (RAMP UP) of LEAP engines, we are looking for Repair Operators/Body Shop Painters to strengthen our teams.

As a Repair Operator/Body Shop Painter, you carry out various tasks related to repairs and adjustments on aircraft engine parts

• You will review the work documents that contain the necessary elements to perform the tasks (materials, products, technical instructions, references to the reference documents, and procedures);
• You perform the assigned tasks accurately and respect the planning in order to avoid any negative impact on work organization, scheduling, or complaints from internal customers.
• You will use the required PPE when performing tasks according to the rules defined by HSE or the usual regulations within SAESB (e.g., risk analysis);
• You report clearly and precisely on identified issues, difficulties, or risks related to the activity or the product, using the designated reporting tools;
• You communicate the status of the activity/activities at the end of the shift;
• You will participate in working groups to analyze problems and improve work processes (continuous improvement, error and defect analysis and correction, internal and external audits, etc.).

Your profile:

• You hold a secondary education diploma in a technical field.
• You have a good knowledge of technical English and a basic understanding of Dutch or French, with the desire to improve it.
• You are willing to work in 2 shifts (6am - 2pm or 2pm - 10pm).
• You enjoy working in a team, in a multilingual environment, and are willing to support your colleagues.
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Define the target operating model for Agentic AI within IT project and application delivery.
• Identify activities for AI agents versus human responsibilities, including human-in-the-loop controls, auditability, and escalation.

• Proven expertise in Generative AI, AI agents, and agentic workflows.

• You possess experience with AI-assisted software engineering, multi-agent orchestration, or LLM governance.

• Knowledge of Architecture Decision Records, APIs, and integration architecture.
• Experience with LLM observability tools.

Our client is a well-established global technology and manufacturing organization with over a century of industry expertise. The company develops innovative commercial equipment and intelligent embedded control systems used by businesses and institutions worldwide.

Jobomschrijving

• Design, develop, and maintain embedded firmware using C programming for electronic control systems.
• Develop reliable and efficient software solutions for next-generation embedded products.
• Create and execute test plans and validation activities to ensure product quality and performance.
• Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to validate firmware on prototypes and production units.
• Perform root cause analysis, troubleshooting, and debugging of firmware and hardware integration issues.
• Optimize communication and interaction between embedded systems, peripherals, and control components.
• Work extensively with embedded interfaces and peripherals, including UART, I2C, ADC, PWM, EEPROM, timers, and interrupts.
• Support new product development initiatives, feature enhancements, and product releases.
• Manage firmware revisions, documentation, and engineering change activities.
• Utilize source control and issue-management tools to support structured development practices.
• Provide technical support to manufacturing teams during pilot builds and production deployments.
To apply online please click the 'Apply' button below. For a confidential discussion about this role please contact Gift Petto on  66 2 012 5067.

• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
• Minimum 7 years of experience in embedded firmware development.
• Strong proficiency in C programming for embedded systems.
• Hands-on experience working with microcontrollers and embedded communication protocols.
• Solid understanding of UART, I2C, ADC, PWM, EEPROM, interrupt handling, and timer-based applications.
• Proven experience in debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization of embedded applications.
• Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.

• Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving capability, and attention to detail.
